affected_party: Organizations using multiple human or AI evaluators
actual_problem: Aggregate judgments can erase dissent, conceal shared dependencies, preserve stale conclusions as current, or remove inconvenient evidence without an auditable retirement decision.
why_it_matters: A successful aggregate verdict can create false confidence when independent lane evidence, minority concerns, and revision history are no longer inspectable.
why_now: QIF v0.7.3 now bounds cross-domain transfer; the next roadmap gap is durable, reusable multi-agent judgment memory.
